cases.title: Start a run from content without the gate
steps: Build and make a temp repo as TESTING.md 'How to see the app' describes

printf '# Add hello

Write hello.txt
' > "$REPO/.git/c.md"
cd "$REPO" && node $CLI --content .git/c.md --provider fake --no-plan-gate; echo EXIT=$?
Read .graph-execution/<run-id>/state.json and git log --stat
cases.expected: EXIT=0, state.json status is "applied", a commit 'Plan: <name>' added docs/prd/<name>.md and .agents/tasks/<name>/*.json, and the planned task's change is on main

cases.title: Approval gate, then approve
steps: In a fresh temp repo run node $CLI --content .git/c.md --provider fake; echo EXIT=$?
Check state.json, then run node $CLI --resume --run <run-id> --approve-plan; echo EXIT=$?
cases.expected: The first command exits with EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL and status "awaiting-approval"; the resume exits 0 and status becomes "applied". --resume without --approve-plan or --replan on that run exits 2 and names both flags

cases.title: Refs with one unclear item
steps:
printf '# A
clear

# B
NOT-READY: B
' > .git/c.md and echo '[{"ref":"A"},{"ref":"B"}]' > .git/refs.json in a fresh temp repo
node $CLI --content .git/c.md --refs .git/refs.json --provider fake --no-plan-gate; echo EXIT=$?
Separately run with content 'NOT-READY' and no refs
cases.expected: The first run ends applied with plan.dropped == ["B"] and questions for B in state.json; the second exits with EXIT_NEEDS_INFO and status "needs-info" with questions

cases.title: API token lifecycle
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md '## graph-manager' describes and log in with the cookie
POST /api/tokens {"name":"t","scopes":["runs:read","workspaces:read"]} with the cookie
GET /api/v1/workspaces with Authorization: Bearer <token>, then GET /api/tokens, then DELETE /api/tokens/<id> and repeat the v1 call
cases.expected: POST returns a token starting gmt_ once; the v1 call answers 200; GET /api/tokens shows no token or hash; after DELETE the v1 call answers 401 {"error":"invalid token"}; a bearer token on /api/workspaces answers 401

cases.title: Start, gate and approve through /api/v1
steps: With graph-manager running and a workspace cloned from the fake forge, create a token with runs:start runs:read runs:approve
POST /api/v1/workspaces/<ws>/runs {"content":"# Add hello\nWrite hello.txt","provider":"fake","sandbox":false}
Poll GET /api/v1/runs/<runId> until status is awaiting-approval, then POST /api/v1/runs/<runId>/approve and poll until it ends
Open the Approvals page in the browser (agent-browser) before approving and look at it
cases.expected: POST answers 201 {runId, viewUrl}; status goes planning → awaiting-approval (the Approvals page lists it with the spec link and Approve / Request changes) → running → applied; approve on an applied run answers 409

cases.title: Idempotent start and provider default
steps: POST the same start body twice with idempotencyKey "k1"
POST a start without provider on a workspace that never ran
cases.expected: The second POST answers 200 with the same runId; the start without provider answers 400 {"error":"no provider: pass provider or start a run in this workspace once"}

cases.title: Missing scope
steps: With a token holding only runs:read, POST /api/v1/runs/<runId>/approve

cases.title: Extension slot
steps: Start a tiny HTTP server on a free port that echoes request headers
Start graph-manager with GM_EXTENSIONS=demo=http://127.0.0.1:<port> and GM_EXTENSION_SECRET=s, log in, GET /ext/demo/ and open /x/demo in agent-browser
GET /ext/demo/ without the cookie; start graph-manager with GM_EXTENSIONS but no GM_EXTENSION_SECRET
cases.expected: The nav shows 'demo' and the iframe shows the upstream page; the upstream received X-GM-Extension-Secret: s and X-GM-User: admin; without the cookie 401; without the secret startup fails with a clear error
